envelope.description: Bind claims to trusted request and worker lifecycles

body.title: Bind claims to trusted request and worker lifecycles
body.summary: Wire authenticated connection/request-owner context through channel/main-services/router/supervisor, worker entry/dispatch, trusted request/step context and single-thread host. Implement explicit invalidation on real owner loss and cancellation; do not trust owner IDs in MCP args or serialize connection capabilities.
acceptanceChecks: Main-thread connection nonce/generation and active internal request-owner registry validate every review claim operation. Worker-supplied args cannot replace bound channel identity or commit/release another connection's claim.
RequestEnvelope/wireRequest and worker dispatch carry only the trusted opaque owner nonce; existing session capability/credential wire exclusions remain.
Worker exit/detach/replacement, disconnect, failed dispatch, explicit cancellation, lifetime completion and local host try/finally clean uncommitted owner claims through actual hooks.

Normal committed receipts survive cleanup; legitimate uncancelled unary work retains its owner until actual completion. No abandoned pinned claim, timed lease regrant or late-owner advancement is permitted.
Real two-connection/worker-exit/cancel and single-thread tests verify the hooks, not only direct store stubs; unrelated step kinds and maintenance behavior remain unchanged.

tests.name: src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-owner-lifecycle.test.ts: real worker connection request and exit cancellation hooks bind and invalidate trusted owners
src/daemon/steps/__tests__/step-host.test.ts: single-thread owner registration cleanup and out-of-band trusted context preserve non-review behavior
